title: Vertex AI MaaS raw proxy must post to the /endpoints/openapi base URL
answers: Vertex AI MaaS raw proxy request returns 404 or wrong URL
gateway proxy route for Llama or Mistral on Vertex builds endpoints/chat/completions
why does /gateway/proxy for vertex partner models miss /openapi
raw passthrough to Vertex MaaS deepseek model hits the wrong path
body:
Symptom: Raw proxy calls (/gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/...) to Vertex AI MaaS models (Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek) go to .../endpoints/chat/completions instead of .../endpoints/openapi/chat/completions.
Root cause: _VertexAIMaaSProvider inherits the OpenAI-compatible _proxy, which calls proxy_root_url() on _api_base to strip a trailing /v1. For Vertex the stripped segment is /openapi, which is part of the API root.
Fix pattern: _VertexAIMaaSProvider._proxy posts to self._api_base unchanged, after path.lstrip("/") and removeprefix("v1/") on the caller's path. Keep the streaming check and the _get_headers(headers) call as in the base.
Constraints: Applies only to the raw proxy path; the chat and embeddings adapters are not affected. Do not fix this by changing proxy_root_url or _api_base, since other OpenAI-compatible providers rely on the /v1 strip.
Invariant: the client's authorization header must not be forwarded next to the Vertex bearer token; _get_headers replaces it (asserted in test_maas_proxy_posts_to_openapi_endpoint).
applies: Any change to raw proxy routing or headers for Vertex AI MaaS (_VertexAIMaaSProvider) models.
says: Raw gateway proxy requests to partner models on Vertex AI return 404 not found errors.
Direct passthrough calls to hosted open-source models route to the wrong upstream URL path.
Fix gateway proxy routing so requests to third-party Vertex models reach the correct endpoint.
Proxying chat completions to Mistral or Llama on Vertex hits an invalid service address.
search: The Vertex AI MaaS raw proxy implementation in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIMaaSProvider._proxy must post directly to self._api_base without stripping the /openapi path segment. Inherited proxy logic incorrectly stripped /openapi as if it were a /v1 prefix, sending partner model calls like Llama, Mistral, and DeepSeek to invalid URLs. Fixing this requires posting to self._api_base while keeping caller path stripping, streaming checks, and header replacement via _get_headers. Applies exclusively to the raw proxy route for Vertex MaaS models; chat adapters, embeddings adapters, and generic proxy_root_url logic must not be modified.
